overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep, relatable relationship dynamics—specifically husband-wife and complex family bonds—significantly outperform general sad shayari or broad motivational content. The clear outlier winners focus on marriage realities, generating nearly 10x to 80x the views compared to low-performing abstract poetry.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,768 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,677 views) heavily outperform all other content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on married life nuances, unspoken compromises, and everyday couple psychology.

winning_patterns.evidence: Content touching on daily emotional weights like 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' (390 views) and 'Ek Mard Bhi Kabhi Ladka Tha' (297 views) perform moderately well compared to abstract text-on-screen poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific, everyday domestic or emotional friction points instead of abstract philosophical lines.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract Sad Shayari & Heavy Poetic Language
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained only 20 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or cryptic phrasing in titles and hooks; keep the language natural and conversational.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional videos (e.g., jfmMztnam_A with 19 views) underperformed drastically compared to parental or marital bonds.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from niche sibling dynamics and concentrate primarily on marital, parental, and individual self-reflection themes.
